tasks.title: Define the closed intent taxonomy
tasks.objective: Create precise, reviewable definitions for every supported intent and the unknown outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Every existing intent has include, exclude, confusableWith, allowedFirstTools, and risk fields
Every referenced tool exists in the tool-name schema
Unknown input behavior is documented without authorizing a tool
Duplicate and unknown intent IDs fail validation
validation: Unit tests for valid and invalid taxonomy files

tasks.title: Define knowledge-store schemas
tasks.objective: Define strict Zod contracts for all externalized language knowledge.
deliverables: Schemas for phrases, domains, entities, constraints, abbreviations, confusing pairs, thresholds, datasets, and manifests
acceptanceCriteria: All knowledge files use strict schemas
Unknown fields are rejected
Cross-file IDs can be checked by the loader
Regex source and flags are represented as data rather than executable code
validation: Schema fixture tests for each knowledge type

tasks.title: Implement explicit unknown and ambiguity decisions
tasks.objective: Make unsupported and ambiguous requests reliably use the existing clarification fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: No-match input routes to ask_clarification
Tied or near-tied candidates route to ask_clarification
Unsupported domains route to ask_clarification
The public AgentInput schema remains backward compatible in phase 1
validation: Unit tests for no-match, tie, unsupported-domain, and clear-intent cases

tasks.title: Define the utterance dataset contract
tasks.objective: Create a versioned JSONL format for labeled English requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Records include ID, text, intent, entities, constraints, source, and split
Duplicate record IDs are rejected
Unknown intents and invalid splits are rejected
Validation reports line numbers for malformed JSONL
validation: Tests with valid, malformed, duplicate, and unknown-intent records

tasks.title: Create balanced baseline datasets
tasks.objective: Establish training, validation, and untouched test sets before expanding classification rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Every intent has direct, polite, fragment, long-form, typo, negative, and near-neighbor examples
Unknown and clarification examples are included
No record appears in more than one split
The test set is marked immutable for the release cycle
validation: Dataset distribution and duplicate-content report

tasks.title: Build the baseline evaluator
tasks.objective: Measure the current rule classifier before changing its language coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Reports precision, recall, F1, and confusion matrix by intent
Reports unknown precision and recall, fallback rate, and incorrect routing rate
Evaluation is deterministic for a fixed release
Command exits nonzero when configured release gates fail
validation: Metric tests using a small dataset with hand-calculated expected results

tasks.title: Implement technical-span protection
tasks.objective: Detect spans that normalization must not rewrite.
deliverables: Extractors for files, directories, URLs, quotes, symbols, errors, and stack traces
acceptanceCriteria: Every span includes type, value, start, and end offsets
Overlapping spans resolve deterministically
Windows and POSIX paths are supported
Original offsets remain valid after detection
validation: Table-driven tests for each span type and overlap case

tasks.title: Implement safe English normalization
tasks.objective: Create comparison text without losing technical meaning.
deliverables: Unicode, whitespace, casing, contraction, and abbreviation normalization
acceptanceCriteria: Original input is preserved exactly
Comparison text uses Unicode NFKC and normalized whitespace
Safe contractions expand only outside protected spans
Code identifiers, paths, URLs, and errors are not rewritten
validation: Golden tests containing prose mixed with technical spans

tasks.title: Implement the validated knowledge loader
tasks.objective: Load one complete knowledge-store release and reject inconsistent data.
acceptanceCriteria: All files validate before the release becomes available
Duplicate IDs, invalid regexes, unknown intents, and unknown tools fail startup
Loader returns immutable data
Errors identify the file and offending record
validation: Integration tests with valid and intentionally corrupt releases

tasks.title: Externalize existing classifier knowledge
tasks.objective: Move intent phrases, domains, entities, and constraints out of classifier.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: No language phrase table remains hard-coded in classifier.ts
Existing classifier regression tests still pass
Knowledge changes do not require TypeScript recompilation
Every knowledge file declares a version
validation: Snapshot comparison of old and externalized classifier results

tasks.title: Implement evidence-producing phrase scoring
tasks.objective: Replace opaque regex totals with phrase-family scoring and inspectable evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete phrases can outweigh generic words
Every score contribution references a rule ID and source span
Repeated synonyms cannot inflate scores unless configured
Scoring order is deterministic
validation: Unit tests for specificity, repetition, tie, and conflicting-evidence cases

tasks.title: Implement negation detection
tasks.objective: Prevent prohibited actions from being classified as requested actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not run tests does not route to run_tests
Do not edit becomes a prohibition constraint
Negation scope handles coordinated clauses in the supported grammar
False negation from unrelated words is covered by tests
validation: Positive and negative minimal-pair tests

tasks.title: Implement modality detection
tasks.objective: Distinguish requested actions from hypothetical, optional, future, and permitted actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct commands retain full weight
Hypothetical and future actions receive configured discounts
Permission statements do not automatically become commands
Only explain is represented as a routing constraint
validation: Minimal-pair tests across direct, optional, hypothetical, and future wording

tasks.title: Implement typed entity extractors
tasks.objective: Extract typed technical entities while preserving compatibility with string entities.
deliverables: Extractors for paths, symbols, frameworks, languages, errors, URLs, packages, and versions
acceptanceCriteria: Entities include type, value, confidence, and available spans
Duplicate entities are merged deterministically
Existing entities string array remains populated
Entity extraction metrics can be computed from dataset labels
validation: Entity fixtures and precision/recall evaluation

tasks.title: Implement structured constraint extraction
tasks.objective: Extract scope, compatibility, prohibition, approval, and validation constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Negated actions become explicit constraints
Minimal-change and preserve-behavior language is recognized
Only and without constructions are covered
Unknown constraints are preserved as unhandled evidence rather than discarded
validation: Constraint extraction tests for each supported category

tasks.title: Implement clause splitting
tasks.objective: Split coordinated requests into ordered clauses without breaking protected spans.
acceptanceCriteria: And, then, after, before, and punctuation sequences are supported
Quoted text and code expressions are not split
Negation scope is retained per clause
Clause order matches user order
validation: Golden tests for single and multi-clause requests

tasks.title: Implement ordered multi-intent planning
tasks.objective: Represent primary and secondary requested actions without silently discarding work.
acceptanceCriteria: Each clause is classified and validated independently
Primary intent and nextAction remain compatible with the existing router
Secondary actions retain order and constraints
Schema-version migration is documented before exposing actions publicly
validation: Tests for find-fix-test, explain-only, and mixed prohibited actions

tasks.title: Calibrate confidence thresholds
tasks.objective: Replace intuitive confidence formulas with validation-derived thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: Thresholds are configurable by intent and risk
Absolute score and top-two margin are calibrated
Calibration error is reported
High-risk actions require stricter thresholds than read-only actions
validation: Validation-set calibration test and threshold regression report

tasks.title: Build the classification orchestrator
tasks.objective: Compose normalization, rules, extraction, planning, confidence, validation, and fallback behind classifyIntent.
acceptanceCriteria: All outputs pass agentInputSchema
Unknown and ambiguous input never bypasses fallback
Classification includes traceable evidence in diagnostics
Existing public imports remain compatible or have a documented migration
validation: End-to-end classifier tests across the validation dataset

tasks.title: Strengthen router policy checks
tasks.objective: Keep authorization independent from classification and enforce risk-aware routing.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifier confidence cannot bypass intent/tool allowlists
Missing required entities force clarification
Prohibited actions are not executed
Tool arguments are validated by tool-specific schemas
validation: Router security and policy matrix tests

tasks.title: Add regression and release quality gates
tasks.objective: Prevent classifier and routing quality from silently regressing.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatically executed intents reach at least 95 percent precision
All routed packets pass schema validation
No high-risk action occurs below threshold
Regressions fail CI unless explicitly approved
validation: Run release gates against baseline and intentionally degraded classifiers

tasks.title: Implement privacy-safe classification telemetry
tasks.objective: Capture evidence needed for improvement without storing secrets or private code.
acceptanceCriteria: Events include release version, candidates, matched rule IDs, fallback reason, and correction ID
Credentials and tokens are redacted before persistence
Raw source code is not stored
Telemetry can be disabled
validation: Redaction tests with representative secret formats and code snippets

tasks.title: Implement the correction review workflow
tasks.objective: Turn reviewed low-confidence and corrected requests into safe dataset improvements.
acceptanceCriteria: Production logs never enter datasets automatically
Promoted examples record reviewer, source, and consent metadata
Duplicates and split leakage are detected
Every promoted regression receives a test
validation: Workflow test from redacted event through reviewed dataset record

tasks.title: Define the immutable release manifest
tasks.objective: Bind compatible knowledge, thresholds, datasets, metrics, and optional model artifacts into one release.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest records every component version and checksum
Incomplete or mixed releases are rejected
Previous rollback version is recorded
Evaluation report checksum is included
validation: Manifest validation and tamper-detection tests

tasks.title: Implement atomic release loading and rollback
tasks.objective: Switch complete classifier releases without serving partial state.
acceptanceCriteria: A classifier instance uses exactly one release version
Failed validation leaves the active release unchanged
Rollback restores the previous verified release
Concurrent classifications never observe partial updates
validation: Concurrency, corrupt-release, activation, and rollback integration tests

tasks.title: Benchmark self-hosted statistical baselines
tasks.objective: Determine whether a local model improves paraphrase and unknown coverage over deterministic rules.
deliverables: Latency, memory, size, and quality comparison
acceptanceCriteria: All models use identical dataset splits
Results are compared against the released rule baseline
Unknown detection and calibration are evaluated
No model is selected solely by aggregate accuracy
validation: Reproducible benchmark report on the untouched test set

tasks.title: Implement the local model interface
tasks.objective: Isolate optional self-hosted inference behind a replaceable contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter returns ranked intent candidates only
Model version is exposed
Inference has timeout and resource limits
Classifier operates in rule-only mode when the model is absent
validation: Adapter contract, missing-model, timeout, and deterministic-fixture tests

tasks.title: Implement and evaluate hybrid decisions
tasks.objective: Combine rules and local model candidates without weakening deterministic safety behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Safety and negation rules remain authoritative
Model output cannot bypass validation or router policy
Hybrid mode improves agreed test metrics over rule-only mode
Unknown detection does not regress beyond the approved limit
validation: Full release evaluation in rule-only and hybrid modes

tasks.title: Document operations and release procedures
tasks.objective: Provide repeatable guidance for knowledge updates, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: A new contributor can validate and package a release from the documentation
Rollback steps are tested
Privacy and approval requirements are explicit
Current supported and unsupported language patterns are listed
validation: Dry-run a complete release and rollback using only the runbooks
